properties.decision:
The `live_nodes > export_nodes` comparison in `sync_debt` STAYS AS IT IS. No second detector is built for the property-only case it misses. What changes is that the in-step line now says what a node count cannot see, so its quiet stops reading as a guarantee.

`write_gen` — the per-process write counter on `ReflowService` — is REJECTED as the instrument, not deferred.

📌 HOW THIS DIFFERS FROM THE THREE NODES IT WAS OFFERED AGAINST, having read them: `dec:idea-the-graph-notices-the-record-moved-without-being-asked` decided the check should EXIST and be gated on a content hash; `fact:defect-nothing-in-the-loop-reports-unexported-work-...` recorded that in_step was being misread; `fact:the-early-export-is-...-invisible-to-the-net` measured how far the resulting proxy falls short. All three are about the finding. This one is about the INSTRUMENT: which mechanism to measure with, and the ruling that no further mechanism gets built.
properties.name: DECIDED — the unexported-work check keeps its node-count proxy and names its blind spot; write_gen is rejected
properties.rationale:
Anthony's word, 2026-08-31, on a recommendation with its counter-argument stated.

═══ WHY NOT write_gen ═══
It is an `AtomicU64` on the service and RESETS ON RESTART. A session that starts fresh reads generation 0 against a recorded 57 and the comparison says CLEAN — a false all-clear, which is the one direction a safety net must never fail in. Making it fail safe means reading "lower than recorded" as "unknown, so nudge", which fires at every session start and teaches people to ignore the nudge. That is worse than the gap it closes. Rejected on the merits rather than parked, so it does not return as an open candidate.

═══ WHY NOT A SECOND DETECTOR AT ALL ═══
The correctness net already covers the reported case, and this was verified in code rather than assumed: `tools/reflow2_check.py` hashes every registered artifact from the working tree, calls `reconcile_artifacts` with `exhaustive: true`, and puts any `checksum_change` into `failures` — a RED BUILD naming the remedy. The 2026-08-30 field report's exact scenario (early export, stale checksum, file on disk moved) fails that gate on the next commit. A second detector for a failure the gate already catches is a duplicated check.

⚠️ AND THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT, which is real and was put before the decision: the gate fires at COMMIT time and only over REGISTERED ARTIFACTS. A wrong export sitting in a working tree between commits is unguarded, and a design change touching no artifact — a property on a Requirement, a status, an edge — is outside the artifact reconcile entirely. So "the gate covers it" is true of the reported case and not of every case. If those become the ones that bite, this decision is the thing to revisit.

═══ WHY THE MESSAGE, AND NOT MACHINERY ═══
The bounds were already written down — all of them, in `SyncDebt::export_nodes`'s doc comment — where no agent and no user has ever read them. The defect was never that the check is incomplete; it is that its silence read as completeness. This project has already chosen that same remedy three times (`open_questions`'s hint on an empty answer, `detect_defects`'s `swept.note` and `coverage_note`, `detect_gaps`'s `share_of_anchored`), so this is a fourth instance of an established pattern rather than a first instance of a new mechanism.

📌 EDGE COUNTING WAS ALSO CONSIDERED AND IS RULED OUT BY AN EXISTING COST ARGUMENT, recorded on the same field: counting edges means walking every node's adjacency, which costs what the export costs, and paying that on the path every ordinary session takes is the thing this check exists to avoid.

⭐ ONE PREMISE HAS MOVED AND IS RECORDED HERE SO THE NEXT READER MEETS IT. The decision that keeps the EXACT comparison off the ordinary path — pinned by `the_expensive_export_is_not_built_on_the_ordinary_path` — was taken when `build_export_doc` measured 1,137 ms. It has measured 236.5 ms since 2026-08-25, a 4.8x improvement, and nothing revisited it. The closure argument still holds on the common path, so nothing changes today; but that decision now cites a cost that is no longer true, and exactness is the door if the uncovered cases above ever start to bite.
